findings.description: App::FeaturePython scratch instances have no Joint proxy attached -- Distance/Distance2/Angle permanently read __MISSING__
findings.disposition_reason: SUPERSEDES the 2026-07-25T06:25:06Z entry's disposition for this finding. The prior fix (bare doc.addObject() + JointObject.Joint() wrapped in defensive try/except) was verified live against a spawned FreeCADCmd instance and found to be a SILENT NO-OP: JointObject.Joint() on a bare document object raises "'NoneType' object has no attribute 'Type'" (it needs an owning Assembly whose Type attribute JointObject.py reads) -- the except was swallowing this every time, so the fix looked complete in code review but produced zero actual improvement. Corrected to mirror assembly_ops.py's real setup: create/reuse a scratch Assembly::AssemblyObject with Type='Assembly', get its JointGroup via UtilsAssembly.getJointGroup(), create the App::FeaturePython there, then attach the Joint proxy. Verified live end-to-end via the actual build_remote_scan_code() pipeline: all 12 App::FeaturePython properties (Angle, AngleMax, AngleMin, Distance, Distance2, EnableAngleMax, EnableAngleMin, EnableLengthMax, EnableLengthMin, Label, LengthMax, LengthMin) now resolve to real property-type-id strings, zero __MISSING__. This is the clearest instance in this whole session of why 'looks complete + passes review' isn't the same as 'verified' -- the bug was invisible without live FreeCAD.
